brief: Treat the cooling control as one stage unavailable because the cooling fans failed to start on manual test at the control cabinet, and apply the required de-rating as specified in MG-021. Top up the transformer oil because the oil level sight glass is reading below the minimum mark at ambient. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, in accordance with MG-021.
